column1: Sympathy: Show how that character has been unjustly punished by the world.
Skill: Describe what they're excellent at and why it's impressive.
Personality: Your character has a unique voice wit or special way of seeing the world.
Progression: The character is going to master and learn a skill or craft.
Worthy Cause: Character is striving for a hard-to-reach ideal.
Underdog: The character is at a clear disadvantage but keeps trying anyway.
Resilience: The character endures hardship without giving up.
Mystery: There is something unknown or hidden about the character.
Loyalty: The character stands by others even when it costs them.
Sacrifice: The character gives up something important for others.
Humor: The character brings levity in tense or serious situations.
Unpredictable: You never know what they're gonna do next.
Defiance: The character stands up against authority or injustice.
Vulnerability: The character allows others to see their weaknesses.
Redemption Arc: The character seeks to make up for past wrongs.
Curiosity: The character’s drive to understand things leads them into interesting situations.
